name: Cetirizine
summary: A commonly used allergic-rhinitis and urticaria drug that is usually less sedating than first-generation antihistamines but not always fully non-sedating.
good: Allergic symptoms when a relatively low-sedation antihistamine is needed.
bad: Situations where daytime sedation is unacceptable unless the patient already knows their response.
clinicalPearls: Second-generation does not mean zero-sedation; it means lower CNS burden on average.
mechanism: Peripheral H1 receptor blockade reduces histamine-mediated itch, sneeze, and runny nose symptoms.
indications: Allergic rhinitis, urticaria, and itch-related allergic symptoms.
interactionNotes: Alcohol and other sedatives can magnify drowsiness.

warnings: Sedation can still occur, especially in sensitive individuals or at higher doses.
